items.title: Elevators
items.author: Jrh0203
items.summary_zh: 这个关于电梯的Hacker News讨论帖引发了广泛关注，话题涵盖电梯调度算法、等待时间优化和现代电梯系统的智能控制技术。电梯作为城市垂直交通的核心设施，其运行效率直接影响着人们的生活和工作体验。讨论中提到的智能电梯系统利用AI进行客流预测和动态调度，能够显著减少等待时间，这一看似平凡的设备背后其实藏着丰富的系统工程和算法设计学问。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled "Elevators" has sparked a wide-ranging discussion about the technology behind vertical transportation. The conversation covers elevator dispatch algorithms, wait time optimization, and the emerging role of AI in modern elevator systems. While elevators seem mundane, they represent a fascinating intersection of mechanical engineering, control systems, and operations research. Smart elevator systems now use predictive algorithms and AI to anticipate traffic patterns and dynamically optimize car assignment, significantly reducing wait times in busy buildings. The discussion highlights how an overlooked everyday technology contains deep engineering challenges — from load balancing during rush hour to energy efficiency — making it a compelling topic for engineers and urban technology enthusiasts.

items.title: UEFA and its national associations will not participate in FIFA competitions
items.author: dickfickling
items.summary_zh: UEFA及其成员国足协宣布将不参加FIFA旗下赛事，这是国际足球管理体系的重大分裂。起因是全球足球管理机构之间的权力和利益分配矛盾日益激化，特别是关于赛事日程和扩军计划的争议。这一决定可能重塑国际足球赛事的格局，对球员、俱乐部和球迷都将产生深远影响，也可能导致国际足球出现双轨制局面。
items.summary_en: UEFA and its national associations have announced they will boycott FIFA-organized competitions, marking an unprecedented fracture in international football governance. This escalation stems from long-simmering disputes over match scheduling, competition format expansion, and revenue distribution between the two governing bodies. The decision could split the global football landscape into competing jurisdictions, with profound implications for players, clubs, and national teams who may face conflicting commitments. For the sport's fans, it risks creating confusion around international tournaments and disrupting established traditions. This is a power struggle with existential stakes for the world's most popular sport.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
items.author: gitpusher42
items.summary_zh: 一个开源项目实现了在2GB内存的M系列Mac上本地运行Gemma 4 26B模型。通过先进的量化技术和内存优化算法，这个引擎大幅降低了运行大语言模型的硬件门槛。普通Mac用户无需昂贵的工作站或云端服务，就能在本地运行强大的AI模型，既保护了数据隐私，又降低了使用成本。对开源AI社区的普及和民主化具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: A new open-source engine enables running Google's Gemma 4 26B model in just 2GB of RAM on any M-series Mac. This is a significant breakthrough for on-device AI, achieved through advanced quantization and aggressive memory optimization techniques. Previously, running a model of this size required substantial memory or cloud computing resources. Now, everyday Mac users can execute powerful language models locally without expensive hardware or cloud subscriptions, while keeping their data private. This project exemplifies the ongoing democratization of AI — lowering the barrier to entry for developers, researchers, and hobbyists who want to experiment with state-of-the-art models on consumer hardware.

items.title: The coolest use for the Vision Pro
items.author: robbiet480
items.summary_zh: Hacker News 热帖认为 Vision Pro 最酷的用法是当随身多屏工作台：连接 Mac 后投射出多个虚拟屏幕，用于编程或设计，而不是玩沉浸视频。评论区的开发者普遍认可这一生产力定位，但也吐槽佩戴舒适度和电池续航仍是硬伤。适合正在评估空间计算设备价值的开发者。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News thread argues the Vision Pro's coolest use is as a portable multi-monitor workstation: pair it with a Mac and project several virtual displays for coding or design, not immersive video. Developers in the comments mostly agree that productivity beats entertainment here, despite complaints about comfort and battery. Worth reading if you're evaluating Apple's spatial computer.

items.title: Read this before you buy that TV streaming stick
items.author: speckx
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章建议购买电视棒前先看清三个隐藏成本：系统占用可用的存储空间、系统更新周期决定设备寿命、主页会推送广告。它对比了 Roku、Fire TV 和 Google TV 的长期体验，认为低价格并不等于低总拥有成本。适合准备购买电视盒子的用户。
items.summary_en: This article warns that cheap streaming sticks come with hidden costs: system files eat available storage, OS updates have a limited lifespan, and home screens show ads. It compares Roku, Fire TV, and Google TV on long-term experience, arguing that a low upfront price doesn't mean low total ownership. A must-read before picking a living-room device.

items.title: Superlogical
items.author: yan
items.summary_zh: Superlogical是一个通过自然语言描述来自动化逻辑推理和流程编排的工具。用户只需用简单的语言说明需求，它就能自动生成可执行的逻辑规则，适合处理复杂的决策树或业务规则。对于那些需要快速验证算法正确性，或者要在系统中嵌入逻辑推理能力的人来说，Superlogical降低了门槛。它像是一个懂你意图的逻辑引擎，把繁琐的规则编写变成对话式的体验。
items.summary_en: Superlogical is a tool that turns natural language descriptions into executable logic rules and workflows. Instead of manually coding complex decision trees or business rules, you simply describe what you want, and it handles the translation. This makes it a game‑changer for developers and analysts who need to quickly prototype or embed reasoning capabilities into their systems. It lowers the barrier for automating logic, transforming a traditionally tedious task into a conversational interaction. Think of it as a logic engine that understands your intent and builds the rules for you.

items.title: Stacked PRs are now live on GitHub
items.author: tomzorz
items.summary_zh: GitHub 今日正式上线堆叠 PR（stacked pull requests）功能，允许把相互依赖的多个 PR 按依赖关系排列成栈，逐层合并。这样大改动可以拆成多个小提交独立评审，适合在长生命周期分支上协作的团队，能明显减少等待和冲突。
items.summary_en: GitHub has officially launched stacked pull requests, allowing developers to group multiple dependent PRs into a stack and merge them in order. This approach lets large changes be split into smaller, independently reviewable commits, which matters for teams on long-lived branches. The feature is now live for all users.

items.title: The session you cannot take with you
items.author: apitman
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 Web 会话的本质：服务端把会话状态绑定在用户当前浏览器，用户一旦离开或关闭标签页，这个会话就无法再被带走或恢复。它剖析了无状态 HTTP 下认证的边界问题，适合前后端开发者思考登录态设计与会话安全。
items.summary_en: This piece examines the ephemeral nature of web sessions: the server ties session state to the user's current browser, so leaving the site or closing the tab makes that session impossible to carry over or restore. It unpacks authentication boundaries under stateless HTTP, useful for developers designing login flows and session security.

items.author: Cider9986

items.summary_en: This open-source engine makes it possible to run the large language model Gemma 4 26B on any M-series Mac with just 2GB of RAM. Through aggressive quantization and memory optimization, it lowers the hardware barrier for running cutting-edge AI locally. This is a game-changer for AI enthusiasts, students, and developers with limited resources, enabling them to experiment and develop applications without expensive cloud GPUs or high-end workstations.

items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Update
items.author: dnhkng
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4-Flash 更新，新一代轻量模型主打更低推理延迟和更省 token 消耗，同时保持较高的编码与逻辑能力。对需要高频调用 AI 的开发者来说，它是一个在成本和响应速度上更平衡的选项，适合做成 Agent 或实时助手。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek released V4-Flash, an update in its model family that emphasizes lower inference latency and more efficient token usage while retaining solid coding and reasoning abilities. Developers making high-frequency AI calls should evaluate it as a balanced option for agents and real-time assistants, especially when cost and speed matter.

items.summary_en: Top AI startups are increasingly keeping their research under wraps, a stark departure from the open publication culture of academia. This piece explores how the shift toward corporate secrecy affects reproducibility, transparency, and the broader AI ecosystem. Researchers and industry observers who rely on published breakthroughs to guide their work will find this analysis particularly relevant, as it raises important questions about the future of knowledge sharing in a field that once thrived on collective progress.

This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. items.summary_en: Ansible is a radically simple IT automation platform that uses human-readable YAML playbooks to automate deployment, configuration management, and application delivery. Its agentless architecture means you don't need to install anything on managed nodes, drastically reducing setup effort. IT operations teams benefit most because it makes automating everything from server provisioning to application updates straightforward and repeatable. It's designed to let you manage thousands of machines with the same ease as one, solving the complexity of modern infrastructure at scale.

items.description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-5.6-Sol, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.5 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Cursor, Copilot, VS Code, Perplexity, and more. Updated regularly.
items.author: asgeirtj
items.summary_zh: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks 是一个 GitHub 项目，它收集了 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 多个大模型的系统提示词，包括 Claude Fable 5、Opus 4.8、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking 等。这些提示词揭示了模型背后如何被引导、如何设定角色和限制，对 AI 研究者和开发者理解模型行为非常有价值。它引发了关于提示工程和模型安全边界的讨论，也是窥探顶级 AI 内部设计的一个窗口。
items.summary_en: This GitHub repository compiles leaked system prompts from popular AI models like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Opus 4.8, as well as OpenAI's ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking and GPT 5.5 Instant. By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.summary_zh: mectrics 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏应用，可以把 Mac 的系统运行状态直接显示在菜单栏里。对想快速查看机器状态的开发者来说很实用；因为是开源软件，代码透明度高，也方便自行修改或审查。
items.summary_en: mectrics is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that puts your Mac's vitals directly in the menu bar. It's a practical choice for developers who want quick system monitoring without paying or trusting closed-source tools, and having the source code available makes it easy to audit or extend.

items.title: SKI
items.description: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
items.summary_zh: SKI是一款免费语音编程工具，支持Claude Code、Codex等主流AI编程助手，让开发者直接用自然语言口述代码指令，无需动手输入。它解决了程序员因键盘操作导致的肢体疲劳问题，同时也为行动不便的群体提供了更友好的编程方式。最吸引人的是它完全免费，降低了尝试门槛，是追求高效无障碍编程体验者的实用选择。
items.summary_en: SKI is a free voice coding tool that works with popular AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex, letting developers dictate commands and code instructions naturally instead of typing. It addresses common issues like repetitive strain injuries and accessibility barriers, making programming more inclusive and comfortable. The fact that it's free lowers the entry barrier significantly, so anyone curious about hands-free development can simply plug it in and start speaking. For developers with physical discomfort or those just wanting a more ergonomic workflow, SKI offers a practical and approachable solution.

items.title: Memmy Agent
items.description: Let every AI remember the same you.
items.summary_zh: Memmy Agent致力于解决AI记忆碎片化的问题，它创建一个统一的用户记忆层，让不同的AI助手和工具都能记住同一个你。无论你使用ChatGPT、Claude还是其他AI产品，你的偏好、背景信息和上下文都能被共享，从而获得高度个性化的连贯体验。对于重度AI用户和追求跨平台一致性的专业人士来说，这款工具能极大提升效率，减少重复介绍和重新设置带来的麻烦。
items.summary_en: Memmy Agent builds a unified memory layer that lets every AI tool remember the same version of you. Instead of each chatbot or assistant starting from scratch, your preferences, background details, and context are shared across platforms, so the experience feels continuous and genuinely personal. This solves a common frustration for heavy AI users who constantly have to repeat themselves or lose important context when switching tools. Professionals who juggle multiple AI assistants in daily workflows will benefit the most, as Memmy reduces redundancy and makes every interaction more informed and tailored. It's an elegant step toward making AI truly understand you, not just handle isolated requests.

items.title: AI Search Console
items.description: Prompt analytics and citation mapping for AI search
items.summary_zh: AI Search Console是一款专门为AI搜索时代打造的提示词分析和引用映射工具。它能帮助品牌和内容创作者追踪自己的内容在ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索引擎中被引用的情况，查看哪些提示词触发了品牌提及，以及竞争对手的可见度如何。对于SEO专业人员、内容营销人员和关注品牌在线影响力的人来说，这是一款极具针对性的数据洞察平台。
items.summary_en: AI Search Console provides prompt analytics and citation mapping for the fast-growing world of AI-powered search. It lets brands and content creators see exactly how their material gets referenced inside AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Perplexity, which prompts trigger brand appearances, and how they compare to competitors. This addresses the emerging challenge of tracking visibility in answer engines rather than traditional Google results. For SEO professionals, content marketers, and brand managers who want to understand their footprint in the AI search landscape, this tool offers essential clarity and actionable data in one focused dashboard.

items.title: Claude Code usage tracking by LangWatch
items.description: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
items.summary_zh: LangWatch 新推出的工具专门为 Claude Code 会话提供成本追踪服务，让开发者清楚知道每次编码会话实际花了多少钱。它能拆解 API 调用、token 消耗和耗时，帮助个人开发者或团队更好地控制 AI 编程预算，优化使用效率。对于重度依赖 Claude Code 的用户来说，这是一款非常实用的成本管理利器。
items.summary_en: LangWatch has launched a new tool that tracks the real cost of your Claude Code sessions, breaking down API calls, token usage, and time spent. It helps developers and teams understand exactly what they're spending on AI coding, so they can manage budgets and optimize usage more effectively. For anyone relying heavily on Claude Code, this is a handy cost-control layer that turns vague anxiety about bills into clear, actionable data.

items.title: NINA
items.description: Guide users step by step inside your product.
items.summary_zh: NINA 是一个产品内引导工具，用于在应用界面中制作分步式新手教程和操作提示。它支持通过可视化配置快速上线引导流程，帮助新用户理解核心功能，适合产品团队优化激活与留存。
items.summary_en: NINA is an in-app guidance tool for building step-by-step onboarding tours and interactive tips directly inside your product. It offers a visual configuration workflow so product managers can launch guides without heavy code changes, helping improve activation and user retention.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: Kimi K3太牛了！但老板说API太贵，让我本地化部署，我算完成本，他涨红脸沉默不语了！其实成本不高，三千万足矣。
items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: Meta 提出算力过剩观点后 AI 股市应声下跌，引发行业焦虑。文章反思 AI 应用三年未爆发的原因：基础设施投入巨大但 killer app 缺失，用户对 ChatGPT 等工具的新鲜感消退，而企业级落地面临成本和安全挑战。作者认为 AI 不会重蹈互联网泡沫，但需要找到像抖音微信那样的超级场景才能引爆下一波增长。
items.summary_en: When Meta suggested there was too much computing capacity, AI stocks tumbled, revealing deep anxiety in the industry. This article reflects on why AI applications haven't exploded after three years: massive infrastructure spending without a killer app, declining novelty of chatbots like ChatGPT, and enterprise deployment hurdles around cost and security. The author argues it's not a repeat of the 2000 dot-com bubble, but AI needs its own TikTok or WeChat moment to trigger the next growth wave. It's a sobering reality check for the industry.

items.title: Codex 穷鬼大救星
items.description: 穷则思变，富则...算了，富哥就不用看这篇文章了！ 为了守护我们钱包，这套穷鬼工作流横空出世！ 欢迎来到 AI 黑心包工队！
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了一套名为“穷鬼工作流”的AI编程方案，旨在帮助预算有限的开发者利用Codex等工具低成本完成项目。作者以幽默自嘲的口吻，将这套方案比作“AI黑心包工队”，强调其核心价值是让手头拮据的程序员也能享受AI带来的效率提升，而不必购买昂贵的付费服务。对于个人开发者和小团队尤其实用。
items.summary_en: This article introduces a budget-friendly AI coding workflow called "Poor Guy Workflow," aimed at helping developers with limited funds leverage tools like Codex to complete projects at low cost. The author humorously dubs it an "AI shady contractor team," emphasizing that it allows coders on a tight budget to enjoy AI efficiency boosts without expensive subscriptions. It's especially practical for indie developers and small teams.

items.title: 携程员工：在携程4年，月薪3万左右，基本没涨薪了。不过挺满足的，毕竟稳定，福利也不错（附Agent面试题）
items.description: 携程员工爆料4年月薪3万没涨薪但满足，14道Coding Agent面试题全解：Prompt组装、上下文三层压缩、Tool与Skill区别、多Agent编排、Plan设计，附源码级回答。
items.summary_zh: 一位携程员工透露自己在公司四年月薪约三万元且几乎没涨过，但他表示挺满足，因为工作稳定、福利不错。文章还附带了14道 Coding Agent 面试题的源码级解析，涵盖 Prompt 组装、上下文三层压缩、Tool 与 Skill 区别、多 Agent 编排、Plan 设计等，对准备 AI 智能体相关岗位的开发者很有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A Ctrip employee shared that after four years at the company, his salary is still around 30,000 yuan a month with almost no raises, yet he feels satisfied because the job is stable and benefits are good. The post also includes detailed source-level answers to 14 Coding Agent interview questions, covering prompt assembly, three-layer context compression, the difference between tools and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and plan design. Developers prepping for AI agent roles will find this a valuable reference.

items.title: 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
items.description: 真实的 AI 开发微信小游戏全流程记录：技术栈、prompt、踩坑清单、成本明细全公开。文末有彩蛋。
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章完整记录了一位开发者利用AI辅助技术从零构建并上线微信小游戏的全过程。作者毫无保留地公开了技术栈、提示词（prompt）设计、遇到的各类踩坑问题以及详细的成本明细，甚至附有彩蛋。对于想尝试用AI加速小游戏开发但又缺乏经验的团队或个人来说，这篇实战复盘提供了真实可参考的路线图和避坑指南，展现了AI在降低开发门槛方面的巨大潜力。
items.summary_en: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of building and launching a WeChat mini game entirely with AI assistance. The author shares everything from the technology stack and prompt engineering techniques to a detailed breakdown of costs and a list of common pitfalls encountered during the process, ending with a hidden bonus. For indie developers or small teams curious about leveraging AI to speed up game development, this real-world case study serves as an invaluable reference. It demonstrates how AI tools can dramatically lower the barrier to entry for game creation, making it accessible even to those without a deep coding background.

items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了如何通过简单五步配置，在本地开发工具中免费无限使用DeepSeek V4 Pro模型，无需充值即可调用其强大能力，甚至还能接入Claude-Code。作者提供了详细的准备工作与操作指南，手把手教用户“薅羊毛”。对于AI开发者和爱好者而言，这是一份极具价值的省钱攻略，能让他们在不花费任何成本的情况下使用顶级AI模型加速编程和创作。
items.summary_en: This tutorial explains how to configure local development tools to use the DeepSeek V4 Pro model for free and unlimited access with just five simple steps, and also covers integrating Claude-Code. The guide, written by a blogger known as 'Xing Ge', provides detailed instructions to help developers and AI enthusiasts leverage top-tier AI models without spending a dime. It is a valuable resource for programmers and creators looking to accelerate their workflows using cutting-edge AI at zero cost.

items.title: 2026 了，前端转 AI 全栈我是这么学的 😍😍😍
items.description: 最近，"前端已死，全栈永生" 又开始在技术圈流行。 支付宝体验技术部已经解散并完成拆分，原有人员分流到各条业务线。这件事传开以后，很多人又往下推一步，变成 "前端作为独立工种肯定会消失"。 更准确的事
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章从支付宝体验技术部解散说起，讨论“前端已死”背后的真实趋势，并给出前端转 AI 全栈的学习路线。作者认为前端作为独立工种不会消失，但技能栈需要重构，还分享了具体的项目实践建议。适合因为裁员焦虑的前端开发者读一读。
items.summary_en: This article uses the disbanding of Alipay's Experience Technology Department to analyze the real trend behind the 'frontend is dead' claim, then maps out a learning path from frontend to AI full-stack development. The author argues that frontend as a separate job won't vanish but its skill stack must be rebuilt, and offers concrete project suggestions. It's a useful read for frontend developers anxious about layoffs.

items.summary_zh: 一位开发者亲测了32个Claude Code实用技能和8个MCP服务器，整理出一套完整的效率提升方案。这些技能覆盖代码补全、重构、调试等关键环节，配合MCP服务器实现任务自动化，让AI编程助手从玩具变成真正的生产力工具。文章强调所有技能均已真实可用，不是理论堆砌，适合所有使用Claude Code的开发者直接上手。
items.summary_en: A developer tested 32 practical Claude Code skills and 8 MCP servers, compiling a comprehensive guide to boost coding efficiency. These skills cover code completion, refactoring, and debugging, while the MCP servers automate repetitive tasks, transforming Claude Code from a gimmick into a real productivity tool. The author emphasizes that all tips have been verified in practice, making this resource valuable for any developer looking to get the most out of their AI coding assistant.

items.title: 没写一行代码！我用 ChatGPT 5.6 (Sol) 做了一个智慧充电站 3D 大屏
items.description: 先说结论。 从设计稿到能在浏览器里打开、点击充电桩弹出状态面板的 3D 可视化大屏，我没有写任何一行代码，没有在 Blender 里手动拖过一次控件，也没有切过一张图。 整条链路交给了 ChatGPT

items.summary_en: The author recounts building a 3D smart charging station dashboard using ChatGPT 5.6 (codenamed Sol) without writing a single line of code. Starting from hand-drawn sketches, the AI generated an interactive 3D scene with clickable charging piles and status panels, all running in a browser. This demonstrates how large language models are lowering the barrier for non-programmers—especially product managers and designers—to prototype and visualize complex interactive experiences quickly.

items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了如何设计一个优秀的AI技能系统，重点介绍了“具身交互智能”这一前沿概念，即让AI拥有身体并能感知世界、理解环境、通过语音表情动作与人自然互动。这一设计理念将推动AI从纯语言模型向多模态、有实体的智能体进化，解决AI在物理世界中行动和感知的难题，对开发者设计下一代人机交互产品具有重要启发意义。

This approach solves the problem of AI operating in physical spaces, enabling more natural human-machine collaboration. Developers building the next generation of smart assistants, robots, or metaverse avatars will find these design principles transformative.

items.title: 为什么 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练如此有效？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练效果好，关键在于把预算集中在强化学习而非简单微调：团队用大规模合成数据构建指令集，配合多目标奖励模型做迭代。相比传统 SFT，这种"小模型筛选、大模型生成"的管线大幅提升了样本利用率和推理表现。对开源社区来说，这套后训练方案比模型权重本身更有工程参考价值。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731's post-training works well because the team shifted most of the budget to reinforcement learning rather than plain fine-tuning: large-scale synthetic instruction data was combined with a multi-objective reward model and iterative rollout. This generation-and-filter pipeline improves sample efficiency and reasoning output compared with standard SFT. For the open-source community, the post-training recipe may be more valuable than the released weights.

items.summary_en: Anthropic recently banned a large number of Chinese developer accounts, causing many programmers who heavily relied on Claude for code generation to lose their main tool overnight. The ban may stem from geopolitical pressure or simply from enforcing terms of service. For individual developers, this is a wake-up call about the dangers of over-reliance on a single AI tool. A more resilient strategy would involve diversifying across domestic models, local deployments, or open-source alternatives.

digest_items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的后训练效果好，关键在于把预算集中在强化学习而非简单微调：团队用大规模合成数据构建指令集，配合多目标奖励模型做迭代。相比传统 SFT，这种"小模型筛选、大模型生成"的管线大幅提升了样本利用率和推理表现。对开源社区来说，这套后训练方案比模型权重本身更有工程参考价值。
digest_items.summary_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731's post-training works well because the team shifted most of the budget to reinforcement learning rather than plain fine-tuning: large-scale synthetic instruction data was combined with a multi-objective reward model and iterative rollout. This generation-and-filter pipeline improves sample efficiency and reasoning output compared with standard SFT. For the open-source community, the post-training recipe may be more valuable than the released weights.

digest_items.title: 最近内存、存储甚至显卡涨价，一个个都说自己要当等等党，等到 2040 年能成功吗？
digest_items.summary_zh: 内存、存储和显卡涨价主因是AI服务器需求挤占产能、原厂调整产出，短期供需错配难以缓解。所谓的“等等党”面对的是长期价格上行，2040年显然只是调侃。对DIY和云计算成本敏感者，建议关注HBM产能与先进制程的节奏。
digest_items.summary_en: RAM, storage, and GPU prices are rising due to AI server demand and factory capacity allocation, creating a supply-demand gap unlikely to ease soon. Waiting until 2040 for a drop is just a meme. DIY builders and cloud users should instead track HBM capacity and advanced-node availability.

digest_items.title: 都说 KMP 算法效率高，现实中真没看到哪些领域用到的最多？
digest_items.summary_zh: KMP算法现实中最常用于文本编辑器的查找、正则引擎、搜索引擎分词和基因序列比对等需要高效子串搜索的场景，但多数时候以封装库出现。它的核心价值在于前缀函数思想，常被内置在底层工具链中。处理超大规模文本或字符串匹配的开发者，学习KMP仍有助于理解性能优化。
digest_items.summary_en: KMP is widely embedded in text editors, regex engines, search indexing, and bioinformatics for substring matching, though rarely written by hand. Its prefix-function idea shapes many low-level tools. Developers working on large-scale text processing can still benefit from understanding KMP for performance tuning.

digest_items.title: 如何看待 Claude 大规模封禁国内开发者账号，让依赖 AI 的程序员「功力尽失」，被调侃天才程序员陨落？
digest_items.summary_zh: 近期Anthropic大规模封禁中国开发者账号，很多依赖Claude写代码的程序员突然失去工具，效率大降，被网友调侃为“天才程序员陨落”。这件事暴露出国内开发者在AI工具上对国外平台的严重依赖，也说明技术出口管制和合规风险正从芯片延伸到软件层。封号背后可能是地缘政治压力，也可能是服务条款的执行。对个人开发者而言，这是一次警醒：过度依赖单一AI工具存在风险，需要多元化方案，比如国产模型、本地部署或开源替代品。
digest_items.summary_en: Anthropic recently banned a large number of Chinese developer accounts, causing many programmers who heavily relied on Claude for code generation to lose their main tool overnight. Their productivity dropped sharply, leading netizens to joke about 'the fall of genius programmers.' This incident reveals how deeply Chinese developers depend on foreign AI platforms, and it highlights that tech export controls and compliance risks are now extending from chips to software services. The ban may stem from geopolitical pressure or simply from enforcing terms of service. For individual developers, this is a wake-up call about the dangers of over-reliance on a single AI tool. A more resilient strategy would involve diversifying across domestic models, local deployments, or open-source alternatives.

digest_items.title: 突发，谷歌地球紧急撤回Nano Banana 2生图功能

digest_items.title: 奥特曼承认：高估了AI抢饭碗！黄仁勋：失业论完全搞反了
digest_items.summary_zh: 谈及AI对就业的冲击时，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman坦言外界高估了失业风险，实际影响远小于预期；NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang则反驳“失业论”，认为AI会放大人类能力，反而催生更多职位。两人态度一冷一热，但共同结论是AI在短期内更多是辅助工具。
digest_items.summary_en: Discussing AI's impact on jobs, Sam Altman admitted the threat of mass unemployment is exaggerated, while Jensen Huang dismissed the jobs-apocalypse narrative, arguing AI will amplify human skills and create more roles. Despite their different tones, both imply AI is currently more of an aid than a replacement.

digest_items.title: 上海雪花膏，破产了
digest_items.summary_zh: 生产“上海雪花膏”的老字号企业近日宣告破产。这个承载几代人记忆的国货品牌，因产品老化、营销落后，被外资品牌和新型国潮挤出市场。对消费行业而言，这是一个传统品牌转型失败的典型样本。
digest_items.summary_en: The century-old manufacturer behind Shanghai's iconic snow cream jars has filed for bankruptcy. The heritage beauty brand failed to modernize its formulations and marketing, losing ground to foreign brands and new domestic rivals. It's a striking case study in how legacy Chinese consumer brands are being squeezed out of a fast-moving market.

digest_items.title: AI来了，大厂中层不好混了
digest_items.summary_zh: 随着AI接管信息汇总、进度同步等协调工作，科技公司开始压缩中层管理岗位。过去靠“上传下达”立足的管理者成了裁员重灾区，而对一线工程师来说，管理岗减少意味着个人贡献者（IC）路线升值，晋升不再只有“带团队”一条路，技术专家同样能吃香。
digest_items.summary_en: As AI takes over coordination duties like information consolidation and progress tracking, big tech companies are cutting middle-management layers. Managers who relied on relaying messages between teams are now layoff targets. For engineers, this means the individual contributor track gains value — promotion no longer requires managing people, and technical expertise alone can pay off.

digest_items.title: 刚刚，OpenAI全新模型Astra曝光！

digest_items.summary_en: OpenAI has revealed Astra, a new model with real-time voice dialogue and multimodal understanding that can identify objects in video and respond on the fly. It's likely to be integrated into ChatGPT in a future release, serving as an upgrade over GPT-4o. For AI developers, this signals that building real-time interactive applications is about to get significantly easier.

digest_items.summary_zh: Meta 最新财报显示自由现金流仅剩 7.84 亿美元，原因是 AI 基础设施投入激增；同日微软发布财报，Azure 云业务增长强劲，纳德拉靠 AI 驱动云业务获得回报。两者对比显示 AI 资本开支已明显影响科技巨头财报，投资者需关注后续投入产出比。

digest_items.title: GitHub AI Agent 翻车：攻击者不用黑客技术，只写一句话就能窃取数据
digest_items.summary_zh: 这次GitHub AI Agent的安全事故令人警醒：攻击者完全不需要利用复杂黑客技术，只需在指令中写下一句恶意提示，就能诱导AI Agent泄露敏感数据。文章深入剖析了攻击原理，指出AI Agent在遵循用户指令时缺乏安全边界，因而被提示注入攻击轻松得逞。这提醒开发者在接入AI Agent时，必须重视输入过滤和权限隔离，避免过度信任，对使用GitHub Copilot等服务的开发者尤其重要。
digest_items.summary_en: A recent security incident involving GitHub's AI agent shows that attackers can steal sensitive data without any hacking skills—simply by embedding a malicious sentence in instructions. The article analyzes how prompt injection tricks the agent into bypassing its intended boundaries, revealing a fundamental lack of safety constraints in current AI agent design. It urges developers to implement strict input validation and permission isolation when integrating AI agents, rather than blindly trusting outputs. This is particularly critical for teams using GitHub Copilot or similar tools in their workflows.

digest_items.title: Agent 成本失控背后：上下文、人工审核与维护成本正在被低估｜请回答 WAIC 2026
digest_items.summary_zh: 文章指出 Agent 实际成本常被低估，除了推理调用，大量开销来自上下文窗口消耗、人工审核流程和持续维护。对正在把 Agent 投入生产的团队来说，这类隐性成本可能比模型 API 费用更快吞噬预算，测算 TCO 时需纳入这些项目。
digest_items.summary_en: Agent deployment costs are often underestimated, with significant hidden expenses from context-window usage, human review loops, and ongoing maintenance beyond raw inference calls. Teams moving agents into production should factor these into total cost calculations, as they can outpace API fees.

digest_items.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin 正式登场：从芯片卷到电网，只为压低每一个 Token 的成本
digest_items.summary_zh: NVIDIA在GTC大会上正式发布Vera Rubin下一代计算平台，不仅升级了芯片性能，更将优化范围扩展到整个电力基础设施。这一代平台强调从芯片到电网的全链路成本优化，目标是把每个Token的生成成本压到最低。对于大规模AI推理和训练用户来说，这意味着更低的运营成本和更高的能效比。
digest_items.summary_en: NVIDIA officially unveiled its Vera Rubin computing platform, marking a strategic shift from chip-level optimization to full-stack infrastructure efficiency. The platform addresses one of AI's most pressing challenges: the soaring cost of powering large-scale inference workloads. By optimizing everything from silicon design to grid-level power distribution, NVIDIA aims to dramatically reduce the per-token cost of AI generation. This matters for enterprises running massive AI deployments, as it directly impacts their operational economics. The announcement signals that the AI hardware battle has moved beyond raw compute into holistic infrastructure efficiency.

digest_items.title: 自构建智能体：一项 LangChain4j 实验

digest_items.summary_en: This article presents an experimental project from LangChain4j that explores self-building agents—agents capable of automatically generating and assembling components for given tasks. The author explains the design rationale, implementation approach, and current limitations, showing how this idea could bring more autonomy and extensibility to AI agents within the Java ecosystem. Though still at an early stage, the experiment offers a novel perspective for developers interested in agent automation and Java-based AI development. It highlights the future potential where agents can adapt themselves to increasingly complex requirements without manual intervention.

digest_items.title: 从金融专业到资深Builder：我如何借多Agent开发工作流，一周做出MVP、一个月上线

The piece offers a practical playbook for non-traditional developers and small teams on distributing analysis, coding, and testing across agents.

digest_items.title: AI浪潮中，如何定义自己的“确定性”之旅？
digest_items.summary_zh: 在AI浪潮席卷各行业之际，如何找到自己的确定性成为普遍焦虑。文章围绕“确定性”这一主题展开，提出面对技术变革，企业和个人都应回归核心能力与长期目标，通过持续学习和迭代构建自身的发展路径。他强调不要被热点裹挟，而要以清晰的价值判断和行动节奏参与AI革命。对于产品经理、技术决策者和创业者来说，这是一篇极富启发性的思考文章。
digest_items.summary_en: As AI transforms every industry, many feel anxious about finding clarity in the chaos. This article explores the concept of "certainty" and suggests that both companies and individuals should anchor on core competencies and long-term goals, rather than chasing every trend. It advocates continuous learning and iteration to carve out a stable development path amid rapid technological change. By focusing on value judgment and consistent action, readers can navigate the AI wave with more confidence. This reflective piece is especially useful for product managers, tech leaders, and startup founders.

digest_items.title: 枫清科技高雪峰：AI正在进入材料研发与化工生产全流程
digest_items.summary_zh: 枫清科技高雪峰分享AI在材料研发与化工生产全流程中的落地实践。从分子设计、配方优化到生产过程的智能调控，AI正在重塑传统化工行业的研发范式。这套方案能大幅缩短新材料开发周期，降低实验成本，帮助化工企业提升生产效率和产品质量。对传统制造业数字化转型具有重要参考价值。
digest_items.summary_en: Gao Xuefeng from Fengqing Technology describes how AI is now embedded across the entire materials research and chemical production pipeline. From molecular design and formula optimization to intelligent process control during manufacturing, AI is fundamentally reshaping how chemical companies innovate. The key insight is that AI can dramatically compress the R&D cycle for new materials while reducing expensive experimental trial-and-error costs. This matters for the chemical industry, which has traditionally been slow to digitize. Manufacturers adopting these approaches can expect faster time-to-market, improved product quality, and more efficient production operations. It's a concrete example of how AI is moving beyond software into physical-world industrial applications.

digest_items.title: Agent 形态一天一个样，Infra 到底该为谁而建？| 请回答 WAIC 2026
digest_items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 Agent 形态快速迭代下，基础设施应围绕开发者、Agent 运行时还是最终用户来建设，指出当前 infra 常追着短期框架跑。对 infra 创业者和平台团队来说，这是投资方向的关键取舍：绑定具体 Agent 架构还是抽象通用层。

For infra founders and platform teams, the question points to a strategic choice between binding to a specific agent architecture or building a generic abstraction layer.

digest_items.title: Elevators

digest_items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled "Elevators" has sparked a wide-ranging discussion about the technology behind vertical transportation. The conversation covers elevator dispatch algorithms, wait time optimization, and the emerging role of AI in modern elevator systems. While elevators seem mundane, they represent a fascinating intersection of mechanical engineering, control systems, and operations research. Smart elevator systems now use predictive algorithms and AI to anticipate traffic patterns and dynamically optimize car assignment, significantly reducing wait times in busy buildings. The discussion highlights how an overlooked everyday technology contains deep engineering challenges — from load balancing during rush hour to energy efficiency — making it a compelling topic for engineers and urban technology enthusiasts.

digest_items.title: UEFA and its national associations will not participate in FIFA competitions
digest_items.author: dickfickling
digest_items.summary_zh: UEFA及其成员国足协宣布将不参加FIFA旗下赛事，这是国际足球管理体系的重大分裂。起因是全球足球管理机构之间的权力和利益分配矛盾日益激化，特别是关于赛事日程和扩军计划的争议。这一决定可能重塑国际足球赛事的格局，对球员、俱乐部和球迷都将产生深远影响，也可能导致国际足球出现双轨制局面。
digest_items.summary_en: UEFA and its national associations have announced they will boycott FIFA-organized competitions, marking an unprecedented fracture in international football governance. This escalation stems from long-simmering disputes over match scheduling, competition format expansion, and revenue distribution between the two governing bodies. The decision could split the global football landscape into competing jurisdictions, with profound implications for players, clubs, and national teams who may face conflicting commitments. For the sport's fans, it risks creating confusion around international tournaments and disrupting established traditions. This is a power struggle with existential stakes for the world's most popular sport.

digest_items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
digest_items.description: 12 Weeks, 24 Lessons, AI for All!
digest_items.author: microsoft
digest_items.summary_zh: 微软推出的《AI for Beginners》课程是一套为期12周、共24课时的免费学习资源，专为零基础学习者设计。课程覆盖机器学习、神经网络、计算机视觉等核心主题，结合实践项目，帮助初学者系统掌握人工智能基础。无论学生还是转行者，都能借此轻松入门AI领域。
digest_items.summary_en: Microsoft's AI for Beginners is a free, structured curriculum that spans 12 weeks with 24 lessons, covering essential AI topics like machine learning, neural networks, and computer vision. It's designed for absolute beginners, offering hands-on projects and clear explanations. This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. It's a perfect starting point for anyone curious about artificial intelligence.

digest_items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
digest_items.author: gitpusher42
digest_items.summary_zh: 一个开源项目实现了在2GB内存的M系列Mac上本地运行Gemma 4 26B模型。通过先进的量化技术和内存优化算法，这个引擎大幅降低了运行大语言模型的硬件门槛。普通Mac用户无需昂贵的工作站或云端服务，就能在本地运行强大的AI模型，既保护了数据隐私，又降低了使用成本。对开源AI社区的普及和民主化具有重要意义。
digest_items.summary_en: A new open-source engine enables running Google's Gemma 4 26B model in just 2GB of RAM on any M-series Mac. This is a significant breakthrough for on-device AI, achieved through advanced quantization and aggressive memory optimization techniques. Previously, running a model of this size required substantial memory or cloud computing resources. Now, everyday Mac users can execute powerful language models locally without expensive hardware or cloud subscriptions, while keeping their data private. This project exemplifies the ongoing democratization of AI — lowering the barrier to entry for developers, researchers, and hobbyists who want to experiment with state-of-the-art models on consumer hardware.

digest_items.title: The coolest use for the Vision Pro
digest_items.author: robbiet480
digest_items.summary_zh: Hacker News 热帖认为 Vision Pro 最酷的用法是当随身多屏工作台：连接 Mac 后投射出多个虚拟屏幕，用于编程或设计，而不是玩沉浸视频。评论区的开发者普遍认可这一生产力定位，但也吐槽佩戴舒适度和电池续航仍是硬伤。适合正在评估空间计算设备价值的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: A Hacker News thread argues the Vision Pro's coolest use is as a portable multi-monitor workstation: pair it with a Mac and project several virtual displays for coding or design, not immersive video. Developers in the comments mostly agree that productivity beats entertainment here, despite complaints about comfort and battery. Worth reading if you're evaluating Apple's spatial computer.

digest_items.title: 别再裸用 Claude Code 了！32 个亲测Skills + 8 个 MCP，开发效率直接拉满！
digest_items.description: 别再裸用 Claude Code 了！32 个亲测技能 + 8 个 MCP 服务器，开发效率直接拉满！ 先晒一下我装完的效果（见下图），所有技能均实测可用。
digest_items.summary_zh: 一位开发者亲测了32个Claude Code实用技能和8个MCP服务器，整理出一套完整的效率提升方案。这些技能覆盖代码补全、重构、调试等关键环节，配合MCP服务器实现任务自动化，让AI编程助手从玩具变成真正的生产力工具。文章强调所有技能均已真实可用，不是理论堆砌，适合所有使用Claude Code的开发者直接上手。
digest_items.summary_en: A developer tested 32 practical Claude Code skills and 8 MCP servers, compiling a comprehensive guide to boost coding efficiency. These skills cover code completion, refactoring, and debugging, while the MCP servers automate repetitive tasks, transforming Claude Code from a gimmick into a real productivity tool. The author emphasizes that all tips have been verified in practice, making this resource valuable for any developer looking to get the most out of their AI coding assistant.

digest_items.title: Read this before you buy that TV streaming stick
digest_items.author: speckx
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章建议购买电视棒前先看清三个隐藏成本：系统占用可用的存储空间、系统更新周期决定设备寿命、主页会推送广告。它对比了 Roku、Fire TV 和 Google TV 的长期体验，认为低价格并不等于低总拥有成本。适合准备购买电视盒子的用户。
digest_items.summary_en: This article warns that cheap streaming sticks come with hidden costs: system files eat available storage, OS updates have a limited lifespan, and home screens show ads. It compares Roku, Fire TV, and Google TV on long-term experience, arguing that a low upfront price doesn't mean low total ownership. A must-read before picking a living-room device.

digest_items.title: Superlogical
digest_items.author: yan
digest_items.summary_zh: Superlogical是一个通过自然语言描述来自动化逻辑推理和流程编排的工具。用户只需用简单的语言说明需求，它就能自动生成可执行的逻辑规则，适合处理复杂的决策树或业务规则。对于那些需要快速验证算法正确性，或者要在系统中嵌入逻辑推理能力的人来说，Superlogical降低了门槛。它像是一个懂你意图的逻辑引擎，把繁琐的规则编写变成对话式的体验。
digest_items.summary_en: Superlogical is a tool that turns natural language descriptions into executable logic rules and workflows. Instead of manually coding complex decision trees or business rules, you simply describe what you want, and it handles the translation. This makes it a game‑changer for developers and analysts who need to quickly prototype or embed reasoning capabilities into their systems. It lowers the barrier for automating logic, transforming a traditionally tedious task into a conversational interaction. Think of it as a logic engine that understands your intent and builds the rules for you.

digest_items.title: Stacked PRs are now live on GitHub
digest_items.author: tomzorz
digest_items.summary_zh: GitHub 今日正式上线堆叠 PR（stacked pull requests）功能，允许把相互依赖的多个 PR 按依赖关系排列成栈，逐层合并。这样大改动可以拆成多个小提交独立评审，适合在长生命周期分支上协作的团队，能明显减少等待和冲突。
digest_items.summary_en: GitHub has officially launched stacked pull requests, allowing developers to group multiple dependent PRs into a stack and merge them in order. This approach lets large changes be split into smaller, independently reviewable commits, which matters for teams on long-lived branches. The feature is now live for all users.

digest_items.title: The session you cannot take with you
digest_items.author: apitman
digest_items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 Web 会话的本质：服务端把会话状态绑定在用户当前浏览器，用户一旦离开或关闭标签页，这个会话就无法再被带走或恢复。它剖析了无状态 HTTP 下认证的边界问题，适合前后端开发者思考登录态设计与会话安全。
digest_items.summary_en: This piece examines the ephemeral nature of web sessions: the server ties session state to the user's current browser, so leaving the site or closing the tab makes that session impossible to carry over or restore. It unpacks authentication boundaries under stateless HTTP, useful for developers designing login flows and session security.

digest_items.title: usekaneo/kaneo
digest_items.description: 🎯 All you need. Nothing you don't. Open source project management that works for you, not against you.
digest_items.author: usekaneo
digest_items.summary_zh: Kaneo 是一个开源项目管理工具，以“所需即所得”为理念，强调极简界面和不冗余的功能设计。它适合希望摆脱重型软件、需要轻量自托管方案的个人开发者或小团队，注重让工具适配用户流程而非相反。
digest_items.summary_en: Kaneo is an open-source project management tool built on a minimalist philosophy, offering only essential features without unnecessary clutter. It targets developers and small teams who prefer a lightweight, self-hosted alternative to heavier project management suites. The project emphasizes adapting to user workflows rather than forcing users to adapt to the tool.

digest_items.title: KOReader
digest_items.author: Cider9986
digest_items.summary_zh: 这款开源引擎能让任何搭载 M 系列芯片的 Mac 仅用 2GB 内存就跑动 Gemma 4 26B 大语言模型。通过极致的量化与内存优化技术，它打破了本地运行大型 AI 模型的高硬件门槛，让普通 Mac 用户也能尝试前沿研究。对于 AI 爱好者、学生和预算有限的开发者来说，这是一个令人兴奋的突破，意味着更低的实验成本和更便捷的本地推理体验。
digest_items.summary_en: This open-source engine makes it possible to run the large language model Gemma 4 26B on any M-series Mac with just 2GB of RAM. Through aggressive quantization and memory optimization, it lowers the hardware barrier for running cutting-edge AI locally. This is a game-changer for AI enthusiasts, students, and developers with limited resources, enabling them to experiment and develop applications without expensive cloud GPUs or high-end workstations.

digest_items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Update
digest_items.author: dnhkng
digest_items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4-Flash 更新，新一代轻量模型主打更低推理延迟和更省 token 消耗，同时保持较高的编码与逻辑能力。对需要高频调用 AI 的开发者来说，它是一个在成本和响应速度上更平衡的选项，适合做成 Agent 或实时助手。
digest_items.summary_en: DeepSeek released V4-Flash, an update in its model family that emphasizes lower inference latency and more efficient token usage while retaining solid coding and reasoning abilities. Developers making high-frequency AI calls should evaluate it as a balanced option for agents and real-time assistants, especially when cost and speed matter.

digest_items.title: SKI
digest_items.description: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
digest_items.summary_zh: SKI是一款免费语音编程工具，支持Claude Code、Codex等主流AI编程助手，让开发者直接用自然语言口述代码指令，无需动手输入。它解决了程序员因键盘操作导致的肢体疲劳问题，同时也为行动不便的群体提供了更友好的编程方式。最吸引人的是它完全免费，降低了尝试门槛，是追求高效无障碍编程体验者的实用选择。
digest_items.summary_en: SKI is a free voice coding tool that works with popular AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex, letting developers dictate commands and code instructions naturally instead of typing. It addresses common issues like repetitive strain injuries and accessibility barriers, making programming more inclusive and comfortable. The fact that it's free lowers the entry barrier significantly, so anyone curious about hands-free development can simply plug it in and start speaking. For developers with physical discomfort or those just wanting a more ergonomic workflow, SKI offers a practical and approachable solution.

digest_items.title: Memmy Agent
digest_items.description: Let every AI remember the same you.
digest_items.summary_zh: Memmy Agent致力于解决AI记忆碎片化的问题，它创建一个统一的用户记忆层，让不同的AI助手和工具都能记住同一个你。无论你使用ChatGPT、Claude还是其他AI产品，你的偏好、背景信息和上下文都能被共享，从而获得高度个性化的连贯体验。对于重度AI用户和追求跨平台一致性的专业人士来说，这款工具能极大提升效率，减少重复介绍和重新设置带来的麻烦。
digest_items.summary_en: Memmy Agent builds a unified memory layer that lets every AI tool remember the same version of you. Instead of each chatbot or assistant starting from scratch, your preferences, background details, and context are shared across platforms, so the experience feels continuous and genuinely personal. This solves a common frustration for heavy AI users who constantly have to repeat themselves or lose important context when switching tools. Professionals who juggle multiple AI assistants in daily workflows will benefit the most, as Memmy reduces redundancy and makes every interaction more informed and tailored. It's an elegant step toward making AI truly understand you, not just handle isolated requests.

digest_items.title: AI Search Console
digest_items.description: Prompt analytics and citation mapping for AI search
digest_items.summary_zh: AI Search Console是一款专门为AI搜索时代打造的提示词分析和引用映射工具。它能帮助品牌和内容创作者追踪自己的内容在ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索引擎中被引用的情况，查看哪些提示词触发了品牌提及，以及竞争对手的可见度如何。对于SEO专业人员、内容营销人员和关注品牌在线影响力的人来说，这是一款极具针对性的数据洞察平台。
digest_items.summary_en: AI Search Console provides prompt analytics and citation mapping for the fast-growing world of AI-powered search. It lets brands and content creators see exactly how their material gets referenced inside AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Perplexity, which prompts trigger brand appearances, and how they compare to competitors. This addresses the emerging challenge of tracking visibility in answer engines rather than traditional Google results. For SEO professionals, content marketers, and brand managers who want to understand their footprint in the AI search landscape, this tool offers essential clarity and actionable data in one focused dashboard.

digest_items.title: paperswithbacktest/awesome-systematic-trading
digest_items.description: A curated list of awesome libraries, packages, strategies, books, blogs, tutorials for systematic trading.
digest_items.author: paperswithbacktest
digest_items.summary_zh: 这是一个系统性交易资源合集，整理了量化交易相关的库、策略、书籍、博客和教程，覆盖回测、风险管理、数据获取等模块。无论你是刚入门还是想找成熟实现，这个列表都按主题组织好了资源，可以省去大量检索时间。
digest_items.summary_en: This curated list aggregates systematic trading resources, including libraries, strategies, books, blogs, and tutorials, spanning backtesting, risk management, and data sourcing. Organized by topic, it helps both beginners and experienced quants quickly find reliable implementations and reference material without extensive searching. The collection is on GitHub and updated by the community.

digest_items.title: huggingface/speech-to-speech
digest_items.description: Build local voice agents with open-source models
digest_items.author: huggingface
digest_items.summary_zh: Hugging Face 新开源 speech-to-speech 项目，可在本地构建语音 Agent，无需调用云端 API。它把语音识别、语义理解与语音合成全流程跑在本地硬件上，主打隐私与离线可用。适合想为桌面或智能家居打造私人语音助手的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: Hugging Face has open-sourced speech-to-speech, a toolkit for building voice agents entirely on local hardware. It chains speech recognition, NLU, and synthesis into one pipeline, avoiding cloud APIs and supporting consumer GPUs. A great starting point for developers creating privacy-focused personal voice assistants, and it targets low-latency, offline-first smart home use cases.

digest_items.title: iv-org/invidious
digest_items.description: Invidious is an alternative front-end to YouTube
digest_items.author: iv-org
digest_items.summary_zh: Invidious 是一个开源的 YouTube 替代前端，允许用户在没有广告和跟踪的情况下观看视频，同时保留订阅、播放列表等核心功能。它也能配合 Tor 或代理使用，适合注重隐私以及希望自建 YouTube 客户端的用户。
digest_items.summary_en: Invidious is an open-source alternative front-end to YouTube that lets you watch videos without ads and tracking, while still supporting subscriptions, playlists, and other core features. It can also be used through Tor or a proxy. This is ideal for privacy-conscious users or anyone who wants to self-host their own YouTube client.

digest_items.title: Claude Code usage tracking by LangWatch
digest_items.description: See what your Claude Code sessions actually cost
digest_items.summary_zh: LangWatch 新推出的工具专门为 Claude Code 会话提供成本追踪服务，让开发者清楚知道每次编码会话实际花了多少钱。它能拆解 API 调用、token 消耗和耗时，帮助个人开发者或团队更好地控制 AI 编程预算，优化使用效率。对于重度依赖 Claude Code 的用户来说，这是一款非常实用的成本管理利器。
digest_items.summary_en: LangWatch has launched a new tool that tracks the real cost of your Claude Code sessions, breaking down API calls, token usage, and time spent. It helps developers and teams understand exactly what they're spending on AI coding, so they can manage budgets and optimize usage more effectively. For anyone relying heavily on Claude Code, this is a handy cost-control layer that turns vague anxiety about bills into clear, actionable data.

digest_items.title: MiniMax H3
digest_items.description: Unified video generation for motion design and branding
digest_items.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布统一视频生成模型 H3，面向动态设计与品牌视觉，用户可通过文本或图片生成带品牌风格的动效片段。它把动态图形和品牌规范整合在同一条生成流程里，省去人工调整和多次渲染，适合设计团队快速产出营销素材。
digest_items.summary_en: MiniMax launches H3, a unified video generation model focused on motion design and branding. It lets users create brand-consistent animated clips from text or images, merging motion graphics and brand guidelines into one pipeline. Useful for design teams that need fast marketing or ad assets.

digest_items.title: Codex 穷鬼大救星
digest_items.description: 穷则思变，富则...算了，富哥就不用看这篇文章了！ 为了守护我们钱包，这套穷鬼工作流横空出世！ 欢迎来到 AI 黑心包工队！
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章介绍了一套名为“穷鬼工作流”的AI编程方案，旨在帮助预算有限的开发者利用Codex等工具低成本完成项目。作者以幽默自嘲的口吻，将这套方案比作“AI黑心包工队”，强调其核心价值是让手头拮据的程序员也能享受AI带来的效率提升，而不必购买昂贵的付费服务。对于个人开发者和小团队尤其实用。
digest_items.summary_en: This article introduces a budget-friendly AI coding workflow called "Poor Guy Workflow," aimed at helping developers with limited funds leverage tools like Codex to complete projects at low cost. The author humorously dubs it an "AI shady contractor team," emphasizing that it allows coders on a tight budget to enjoy AI efficiency boosts without expensive subscriptions. It's especially practical for indie developers and small teams.

digest_items.title: NINA
digest_items.description: Guide users step by step inside your product.
digest_items.summary_zh: NINA 是一个产品内引导工具，用于在应用界面中制作分步式新手教程和操作提示。它支持通过可视化配置快速上线引导流程，帮助新用户理解核心功能，适合产品团队优化激活与留存。
digest_items.summary_en: NINA is an in-app guidance tool for building step-by-step onboarding tours and interactive tips directly inside your product. It offers a visual configuration workflow so product managers can launch guides without heavy code changes, helping improve activation and user retention.

digest_items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
digest_items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
digest_items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
digest_items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

digest_items.title: Cleanlist AI
digest_items.description: Natural-language prospecting: find, enrich and sync leads.
digest_items.summary_zh: Cleanlist AI 是一款自然语言销售线索工具：用户用对话方式描述目标客户，它负责查找、补全字段并同步到外部系统。适合销售和增长团队，能减少手动整理线索、保持 CRM 数据更新的工作量。
digest_items.summary_en: Cleanlist AI is a natural-language prospecting tool: you describe your target lead conversationally, and it finds, enriches, and syncs the data. Sales and growth teams can reduce manual lead-cleanup work and keep CRM records up to date.

digest_items.title: 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
digest_items.description: 真实的 AI 开发微信小游戏全流程记录：技术栈、prompt、踩坑清单、成本明细全公开。文末有彩蛋。
digest_items.summary_zh: 这篇文章完整记录了一位开发者利用AI辅助技术从零构建并上线微信小游戏的全过程。作者毫无保留地公开了技术栈、提示词（prompt）设计、遇到的各类踩坑问题以及详细的成本明细，甚至附有彩蛋。对于想尝试用AI加速小游戏开发但又缺乏经验的团队或个人来说，这篇实战复盘提供了真实可参考的路线图和避坑指南，展现了AI在降低开发门槛方面的巨大潜力。
digest_items.summary_en: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of building and launching a WeChat mini game entirely with AI assistance. The author shares everything from the technology stack and prompt engineering techniques to a detailed breakdown of costs and a list of common pitfalls encountered during the process, ending with a hidden bonus. For indie developers or small teams curious about leveraging AI to speed up game development, this real-world case study serves as an invaluable reference. It demonstrates how AI tools can dramatically lower the barrier to entry for game creation, making it accessible even to those without a deep coding background.

digest_items.title: [Apple] 求助！关于如何用 Frida gadget hook ios 软件
digest_items.summary_zh: 这是一条 V2EX 求助帖：发帖人询问如何用 Frida Gadget 对 iOS 软件进行 hook。没有正文，无法获知具体遇到的报错或 iOS 版本等背景；只能判断发帖者是 iOS 逆向方向的开发者。
digest_items.summary_en: This is a V2EX help post asking how to use Frida Gadget to hook iOS software.
